avoid_supplements.name: Scopolia, Jimson weed, Datura
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, tachycardia, CNS effects)
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on anticholinergic symptom recognition

avoid_supplements.name: Belladonna alkaloid-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Synergistic anticholinergic toxicity affecting GI, urinary, and cardiac function
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue herbal anticholinergics; monitor for overdose symptoms

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential minor CYP interactions affecting any systemically absorbed ipratropium metabolites
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for altered efficacy; generally low concern due to minimal systemic absorption

caution_foods.name: High-fiber foods (in excess)
caution_foods.mechanism: Anticholinergic effects may worsen constipation when combined with fiber intake without adequate hydration
caution_foods.action: Ensure adequate fluid intake; monitor bowel function

monitoring_notes: Ipratropium is delivered via inhalation with minimal systemic absorption, resulting in low interaction potential. Primary concern is additive anticholinergic effects with herbal supplements containing muscarinic antagonists; monitor for dry mouth, urinary hesitancy, constipation, and elevated heart rate.
